seo.title: Service Areas in Greater Victoria | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping serves 13 Greater Victoria municipalities, from Sidney and North Saanich to Langford, Sooke and Metchosin, each with its own local rules.

lede: Thirteen municipalities across Greater Victoria. Each area page covers the local rules that affect yard and tree work, with a link to each rule's source.

sections.heading: Local rules differ
body: Tree bylaws, burning seasons, boulevard rules and development permit areas are set by each municipality, so the same job can need a permit in one place and not in the next. A few rules apply across the region instead, such as the CRD watering schedule for properties on the regional water supply and the provincial rules for work near streams and bird nests; those are set by the CRD or the Province, not by the municipality.
Every local rule we summarise links to the page it comes from. Rules change, so check the source or ask the municipality before you rely on one.

sections.heading: Not on the list?
body: If your property is nearby, [get a free quote](/free-quote/) and tell us where it is, or [contact us](/contact/). You can also browse [our services](/services/) and [sample projects](/projects/).
